examples.text: seyyathā'pi rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. evam'evaṃ kho ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ

64003.meaning1: fact of being deeply buried; fact of (something) being deep underground
64003.construction:
su + ni + √khaṇ + ta + tta
sunikhāta + tta

examples.text: dakkhiṇāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, n'eva saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya. taṃ kissa hetu? gambhīrattā, bhikkhave, nemassa sunikhātattā silāyūpassa.

64004.meaning1: carefully held down; firmly pinned down

examples.text: nāsāyaṃ suggahitaṃ gahetvā uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. uparighaṭāyaṃ suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷeyya. daṇḍena sutāḷitaṃ tāḷetvā osajjeyya.
so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggaṇheyya. ajapadena daṇḍena suniggahitaṃ niggahitvā, gīvāya suggahitaṃ gaṇheyya.
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessanti.

64006.meaning1: carefully considered; well thought out; well reasoned

examples.text: api ca, bhāradvāja, sunijjhāyitaṃ'y'eva hoti, tañ'ca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā, no ce'pi sunijjhāyitaṃ hoti, tañ'ca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.

64009.commentary: (DNa) sunidhavassakārā'ti sunidho ca vassakāro ca dve brāhmaṇā. magadhamah'āmattā'ti magadharañño mah'āmattā mahāamaccā, magadharaṭṭhe vā mah'āmattā mahatiyā issariyamattāya samannāgatā'ti

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sunidhavassakārā magadhamah'āmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya. tena samayena sambahulā devatāyo sahass'eva pāṭaligāme vatthūni pariggaṇhanti.
sududdasaṃ sunipuṇaṃ, yatthakāmanipātinaṃ, cittaṃ rakkhetha medhāvī, cittaṃ guttaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ.

te tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa kāyā veḷupesikāhi gūthaṃ sunimmajjitaṃ nimmajjathā'ti

64016.meaning1: easily suppressed; easy to be conquered; easily crushed
64016.meaning2: easily suppressed; easy to be conquered
64016.commentary: (DNa) te na sunimmadayā'ti te āmagandhā sunimmadayā sukhena nimmadetabbā pahātabbā na honti, duppajahā dujjayā'ti attho.

examples.text: yathā kho ahaṃ bhoto āmagandhe bhāsamānassa ājānāmi. te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā. pabbajissām'ahaṃ, bho, agārasmā anagāriyan'ti.
ārāmacetyā vanacetyā, pokkharañño sunimmitā, manussarāmaṇeyyassa, kalaṃgghanti soḷasiṃ.

64018.meaning1: name of a deity; lord of the gods who delight in creation
64018.meaning2: name of a deity; lord of the gods who delight in creation

examples.text: atthi kho, bhikkhu, yāmā nāma devā… suyāmo nāma devaputto… tusitā nāma devā… santussito nāma devaputto… nimmānaratī nāma devā… sunimmito nāma devaputto… paranimmitavasavattī nāma devā… vasavattī nāma devaputto amhehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
pajāpatī tassa sunimmitassa, acintiyā kammavipākā tassa, yam'etaṃ pucchasi kuhiṃ uppannā sā'ti, taṃ te viyākāsiṃ anaññathā ahaṃ.

64020.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sunisedha
64020.meaning1: completely stopping; totally preventing; absolutely ending
64020.construction:
su + ni + √sidh > sedh + *a + aṃ
sunisedha + aṃ

examples.text: yesaṃ te adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyanti, te sunisedhaṃ nisedhenti, mūlaghaccaṃ karonti, sīsāni tesaṃ chindanti.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ sunivattho hoti pattacīvaram'ādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pavisitu'kāmo.
aparaṃ pana ekadivasaṃ uyyānaṃ gacchanto tath'eva devatāhi nimmitaṃ sunivatthaṃ supārutaṃ pabbajitaṃ disvā, ko nām'eso sammā'ti sārathiṃ pucchi.

64023.commentary: (JAa) suniviṭṭhāyā'ti maggena āgatattā suppatiṭṭhitāya. (DNt) suṭṭhu nivesitabbo'ti suniviṭṭho. tathā dunniviṭṭho.

examples.text: saddhāya suniviṭṭhāya, saddhamme suppavedite, akaṃsu satthu vacanaṃ, sammāsambuddhasāsane, tesaṃ etāni ṭhānāni, yāni tvaṃ rāja passasi.

gāmakathā'pi suniviṭṭha-dunniviṭṭha-subhikkha-dubbhikkh'ādi-vasena vā asukagāmavāsino sūrā samatthā'ti vā evaṃ assādavasena na vaṭṭati. sātthakaṃ pana katvā saddhā pasannā'ti vā khayavayaṃ gatā'ti vā vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

64024.meaning2: rightly settled; correctly closed; well put to rest

64025.meaning1: of extremely low intelligence; utterly deficient in wisdom

examples.text: parassa ce dhammam'anānujānaṃ, bāl'omako hoti nihīnapañño, sabb'eva bālā sunihīnapaññā, sabb'ev'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā.

64026.meaning1: (of meaning) plainly obvious; clearly explicit; very straightforward

examples.text: sunikkhittañ'ca padabyañjanaṃ attho ca sunīto. sunikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa attho'pi sunayo hoti.
evaṃ sunītena subhāsitena, dhammena ñāyena upāyaso nayaṃ, nibbāpaye saṅkhubhitaṃ mahājanaṃ, mahā'va megho salilena medinin'ti.

64028.meaning2: name of a minister of Magadha

examples.text: evaṃ ādittako loko, jarāya maraṇena ca, nīhareth'eva dānena, dinnaṃ hoti sunīhataṃ.

kāraggahaṇaṃ kim'atthaṃ? ākār'anta ikār'antā ca honti, paccakkhā dhammā yassa so'yan'ti paccakkhadhammā, surabhino gandho surabhigandhi, sundaro gandho sugandhi, pūtino gandho pūtigandhi, kucchito gandho kugandhi, duṭṭhu gandho yassa so'yan'ti dugandhi, pūti eva gandho pūtigandhi.

examples.text: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasikhi taṇhacchido ca sikhari.

64037.meaning1: better; of better quality; more beautiful (than)
64037.synonym: kantiya, kalyāṇa, nikāma, piya, manāpa, sātarūpa, sādhu, sukha, sundara

examples.text: amhākaṃ kho bhante kulaputtānaṃ kismiṃ viya ekasāṭakaṃ gantuṃ, āgamehi bhante yāva gharaṃ gacchāmi, gharaṃ gato ito vā ekaṃ sāṭakaṃ pahiṇissāmi ito vā sundarataran'ti. kiṃ pana tayā, āvuso, adātu'kāmena pavāritena yaṃ tvaṃ pavāretvā na desī'ti.

64040.commentary: (MNa) sundarikabhāradvājo'ti bhāradvājo nāma so brāhmaṇo attano gottavasena, sundarikāya pana nadiyā sinātassa pāpappahānaṃ hotī'ti ayam'assa diṭṭhi, tasmā sundarikabhāradvājo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.
bāhukaṃ adhikakkañ'ca, gayaṃ sundarikaṃ m'api, sarassatiṃ payāgañ'ca, atho bāhumatiṃ nadiṃ.

64044.commentary: (THIa) tassā rūpasampattiyā sundarī'ti nāmaṃ ahosi. vayappattakāle c'assā kaniṭṭhabhātā kālam'akāsi. ath'assā pitā puttasokena abhibhūto tattha tattha vicaranto vāsiṭṭhittheriyā samāgantvā taṃ sokavinodanakāraṇaṃ pucchanto petāni bhoti puttānī'tiādikā dve gāthā abhāsi. therī taṃ sok'ābhibhūtaṃ ñatvā sokaṃ vinodetu'kāmā bahūni puttasatānī'tiādikā dve gāthā vatvā attano asokabhāvaṃ kathesi.

64049.meaning1: well bathed; cleanly washed; properly scrubbed

idāni te, bhante, taṃ rajojallaṃ pavāhetvā sunhātā suvilittā kappitakesamassū odātavatthā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāressantī'ti.

64053.construction:
su + pati > paty > pacc + √ar + tha + ika
supaccattha + ika

64054.meaning2: well stated; rightly declared; well made known; lit. good caused to know

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāva supaññattā c'ime, bhante, bhagavatā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
ayaṃ paṭipadā supaññattā'ti sayaṃ samattaṃ karoti paripuṇṇaṃ karoti anomaṃ karoti aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ karoti.

64056.meaning1: going the right way; practising well
64056.meaning2: going the right way; practising well
64056.commentary: (DNa) suppaṭipanno saṅgho'ti buddhassa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'pi vaṅk'ādidosavirahitaṃ sammāpaṭipadaṃ paṭipannattā suppaṭipanno'ti pasanno'mhi bhagavatī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho

64060.meaning1: well laid out; properly set out
64060.meaning2: properly at hand; very much present

64061.meaning1: with a mind well established; mentally fully centred (in)

examples.text: santi hi, kandaraka, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sekkhā santatasīlā santatavuttino nipakā nipakavuttino, te catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supaṭṭhitacittā viharanti.

64062.meaning1: (of food) extremely delicious; most excellent; very fine

examples.text: susaṅkhataṃ bhojanaṃ yā dadāti, supaṇītaṃ rasasā upetaṃ, sā dakkhiṇā ujjugatesu dinnā, caraṇ'ūpapannesu mahaggatesu, puññena puññaṃ saṃsandamānā, mahapphalā lokavidūna vaṇṇitā.

64063.meaning2: supernatural bird of prey, arch-enemy of the nāgas

examples.text: ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāyasā te vanam'ajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.
pakkhijāto tadā āsiṃ, supaṇṇo garuḷ'ādhipo, addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ, gacchantaṃ gandhamādanaṃ.

64064.meaning1: mode of reproduction for a supernatural bird of prey

examples.text: katamā catasso? aṇḍajā supaṇṇā, jalābujā supaṇṇā, saṃsedajā supaṇṇā, opapātikā supaṇṇā, imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso supaṇṇayoniyo'ti.

64066.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Supaṇṇasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 30 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: sukhaṃ supati, sukhaṃ paṭibujjhati, na pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati, manussānaṃ piyo hoti, amanussānaṃ piyo hoti, devatā rakkhanti, n'āssa aggi vā visaṃ vā satthaṃ vā kamati

ye'pi te, bhante, bhavissanti anāgatam'addhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhissanti.

64070.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ketumbharāgo ca mātaṅgo ariyo, ath'accuto accutagāmabyāmako, sumaṅgalo dabbilo supatiṭṭhito, asayho khem'ābhirato ca sorato.

64071.meaning1: with a mind well established; with a mind fully centred (in)

examples.text: evam'eva kho me, bhante, dhamm'anvayo vidito, ye te, bhante, ahesuṃ atītam'addhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā sattabojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu.

64072.meaning1: with beautiful banks; with beautiful bathing places

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā.
najjāyo supatitthāyo, soṇṇavālukasanthatā, acchā savanti ambūni, macchagumbanisevitā.
sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, supabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.

64079.meaning1: of excellent workmanship; finely crafted; well prepared

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sāḷha, bhabbo nu kho so puriso nadiṃ taritun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante. taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bhante, sālalaṭṭhi bahiddhā suparikammakatā anto avisuddhā. tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi saṃsīdissati, puriso anayabyasanaṃ āpajjissatī'ti.

64080.meaning1: time of being finely crafted; time of being well prepared

examples.text: evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

64081.meaning1: well practised; well rehearsed; well consolidated

examples.text: atha kho taṃ, ānanda, hatthiratanaṃ, seyyathā'pi nāma gandhahatth'ājāniyo dīgharattaṃ suparidanto, evam'eva damathaṃ upagacchi.

64083.meaning1: completely finished; perfectly completed; fully accomplished

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.

64086.meaning1: well rubbed all around; very pliant
64086.commentary: (MNa) suparimadditā'ti anto ca bahi ca samantato suparimadditā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, biḷārabhastā madditā sumadditā suparimadditā, mudukā tūlinī chinnasassarā chinnabhabbharā. atha puriso āgaccheyya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kathalaṃ vā ādāya.

64087.meaning1: truly well restrained; self-controlled in every way
64087.commentary: (DHPa) te idha lokasmiṃ susaṃvutā surakkhitā sugopitā supihitadvārā'ti attho.

examples.text: kāyena saṃvutā dhīrā, atho vācāya saṃvutā, manasā saṃvutā dhīrā, te ve suparisaṃvutā.

catutthe addasā'ti gaṅgātīre paññattavarabuddh'āsane nisinno addasa. vuyhamānan'ti caturassaṃ tacchetvā pabbat'antare ṭhapitaṃ vāt'ātapena suparisukkhaṃ pāvussake meghe vassante udakena uplavitvā anupubbena gaṅgāya nadiyā sote patitaṃ tena sotena vuyhamānaṃ.
pubb'eva kho pan'assa kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ ājīvo suparisuddho hoti. evam'ass'āyaṃ ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
api ca, bhāradvāja, suparivitakkitaṃ'y'eva hoti, tañ'ca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā, no ce'pi suparivitakkitaṃ hoti, tañ'ca hoti bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
yo sīlavā dussīlesu dadāti dānaṃ, dhammena laddhaṃ supasannacitto, abhisaddahaṃ kammaphalaṃ uḷāraṃ, sā dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati.

suppiyānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. suppiyā, bhikkhave, manussā supassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti, dvīhena orohanti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya, daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā app'esakkhā ca?

64096.meaning1: (of a metal) well quenched; properly hardened in water
64096.notes: refers to the metallurgical process of quenching used to harden steel.

examples.text: asī yathā sunisito, nettiṃso'va supāyiko, sattī'va urasi khittā, kāmā dukkhatarā tato.
aparaṃ pana ekadivasaṃ uyyānaṃ gacchanto tath'eva devatāhi nimmitaṃ sunivatthaṃ supārutaṃ pabbajitaṃ disvā, ko nām'eso sammā'ti sārathiṃ pucchi.

64098.construction:
su + pa + sāde + a + ika
supasāda + ika

examples.text: pāsādiko vat'āyaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo, supāsādiko vat'āyaṃ bhante, dhammapariyāyo, ko nām'āyaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, upavāṇa, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ pāsādiko tv'eva naṃ dhārehī'ti.

64099.commentary: (THIa) samaṇā'ti bhoti supī'ti bhoti tvaṃ supanakāle'pi samaṇā samaṇā'ti kittentī samaṇapaṭibaddhaṃ'y'eva kathaṃ kathentī supasi.

examples.text: samaṇā'ti bhoti supi, samaṇā'ti pabujjhasi, samaṇān'eva kittesi, samaṇī nūna bhavissasi.
